title: Компактация и checkpoint (CAS, lease), restore/REST replace через drain, закрытие и prune поколений
summary: `Persistence\CompactionLeases` и `POST /v1/collaboration/hub/compaction/lease` (C12); `Persistence\Checkpoint::publish()` и `POST /v1/collaboration/hub/checkpoint` (C6, C7: CAS CS/CV/lease_token под L3+L4 через `CollaborativeState::publishCheckpoint`, удаление updates ≤H этой G, marker снимается только при PT ≤ H); `HubDrainer` реализует `PendingStateDrainer` (drain_requested_at + ожидание marker с deadline `drain.restore_deadline` 10 с, вне транзакции); закрытие generation при restore/REST replace (heads.retired_at, EventSink на событие restore documents); `vaulter:collaboration:prune` (C11); пороги `compaction.trigger_updates` 500, `trigger_bytes` 1 MiB, `trigger_age` 600 с; problem `collaboration_checkpoint_conflict` (409).
why: D26 ревизия 3 п.1–3: PHP не мержит Yjs — компактацию исполняет хаб по lease, backend публикует CAS; restore/REST replace при pending включают saved-хвост в revision-снимок либо отказывают 409. Hard risks: проигравшая компактация удаляет непокрытый payload (5); снятие marker при PT > H (20); закрытие generation с непокрытыми receipts (18); prune активной generation; удержание locks во время ожидания drain; публикация по чужому/истёкшему lease.

include: Lease/checkpoint эндпоинты и сервисы; HubDrainer + Internal `DrainWaiter` (подменяемый в тестах фейковым хабом)
Генерация: retired_at при restore/REST replace; отказ append/lease/checkpoint retired G

rules: Публикация checkpoint: CS == C, CV == state_version документа, H ≤ HS, lease_token действителен, G текущая — иначе 409 без изменений и без удаления.
Удаляются только `v_collaboration_updates` (document, G, seq ≤ H) в транзакции успешной публикации; receipts удаляет только prune retired G по C11.
Drain: drain_requested_at ставится отдельной короткой транзакцией; ожидание marker — вне транзакции, опрос с backoff до deadline; затем restore повторно берёт locks и проверяет marker.
Lease выдаётся только документам с marker или drain_requested_at текущей G; lease не даёт права append.
guidance: Фейковый хаб для тестов: реализация `DrainWaiter`, которая на первом опросе берёт lease через HTTP (`compaction/lease`), склеивает checkpoint+tail конкатенацией фиктивных бинарей (Yjs-мерж в PHP не делается — тест проверяет покрытие C..H и CAS, не содержимое Yjs) и публикует `checkpoint`. CompactionCasTest: (4) читать (C,H) → append seq H+1 → publish(H) → marker (G, H+1) остаётся, update H+1 жив; (5) два publish одного (C,H): второй 409, количество updates после первого = HS−H; (20) после (4) REST PUT documents → 409 document_state_pending. RestorePendingTest (18): marker + фейковый хаб → revision содержит все saved receipts (checkpoint_seq ≥ PT) и G+1; хаб не отвечает → 409, G не изменилась, receipts на месте.

result.notes:
Compaction, checkpoint, drain, closing and prune of collaboration generations (D26 rev.3, C6–C8, C11, C12). New in collaboration: Persistence\CompactionLeases (grant: only the document's current open generation with a pending marker that reached compaction.trigger_updates 500 / trigger_bytes 1 MiB / trigger_age 600 s, or with drain_requested_at, drain requests first; a held lease is skipped until lease_ttl 60 s ends; the lease and the checkpoint+tail read happen in one transaction under CollaborativeState::lock() (L1–L3) and then the head FOR UPDATE (L4); requestDrain sets drain_requested_at in its own short transaction). Persistence\Checkpoint::publish: generation fence (409 collaboration_epoch_mismatch for a moved or retired G), lease token held and not expired, CS == C, CV == expected == the document's state_version, C ≤ H ≤ HS, otherwise 409 collaboration_checkpoint_conflict and nothing changes; on success CollaborativeState::publishCheckpoint, delete updates (doc, G, seq ≤ H) only, head := (H, new SV), lease spent, drain flag cleared only when the marker was cleared. Drain\HubDrainer implements PendingStateDrainer (does nothing inside a transaction; drain_requested_at, then Drain\DrainWaiter polls the marker outside any transaction with backoff up to drain.restore_deadline 10 s; the default BackoffDrainWaiter is bound in the registrar and a test binds a fake hub). Persistence\GenerationCloser (EventSink collaboration.generations) sets retired_at on heads of generations below the new epoch in the transaction of DocumentRestored / DocumentContentUpdated. Persistence\RetiredGenerations + vaulter:collaboration:prune (C11: retired_at < now − (hub.token_ttl + 10 s + retention.retired_generation_days 7); first retires heads of generations a document left while the module was off; re-checks under L3+L4 and never touches the current G; --dry-run) + CollaborationSchedule (schedule.collaboration_prune dailyAt:03:40). HTTP: POST v1/collaboration/hub/compaction/lease (vaulter.v1.collaboration.hub.compaction.lease) and POST v1/collaboration/hub/checkpoint (…hub.checkpoint), protocol 2 header required, authenticated by the body HMAC only (new VerifyHubSignature, CollaborationCallResolver::verifyHub), size-gated by LimitHubAppend (checkpoint variant: 4/3·max_state_bytes + request_bytes); route labels; problem code + lang en/ru; OpenAPI paths and schemas; manifest provides PendingStateDrainer and registers the command, the schedule and the sink. UpdateLog::snapshot was split into lock + public read(LockedDocumentState) for reuse by the lease (same statements). Documents: DocumentStateWriter, before a write that moves the epoch, captures a working state that has Yjs state and no checkpoint as an autosave revision (the C8 'revision snapshot': saved receipts are never left out of the history). Tests: CompactionCasTest (4, 5, 20 + CAS variants + HTTP), CompactionLeaseTest (19: triggers, drain priority, max, held/expired leases, retired/left G, no append right, auth/validation/413), ReceiptRetentionTest (6), RestorePendingTest (18, fake hub over HTTP; offline → 409 after a 10 s fake sleep), RestoreFenceTest (13), PruneGenerationsTest, CompactionRaceTest (serial+database, pgsql only, written, not run), CollaborationModuleTest updated, DocumentStateWriterTest +2. Also regenerated: surface snapshot, identities inventory + ledger (11 records, D26) + owners/cli rule, IdentitiesTest counts, baseline lists/ledger, tests/suites.json, zones.json database list, groups.php, Pest.php (Restore uses DatabaseMigrations). packages/vue/src/api/schema.d.ts was written by hand in the exact shape openapi-typescript produced for the P5.4 paths: the sandbox denies reading node_modules and the npm registry, so `npm run api:generate` and `api:check` could not run. To remove one uncertain rendering I dropped `default: 1` from the lease `max` property in the OpenAPI and put it in the description instead.

V8 `scripts/t baseline --compare` exits 1 in the executor sandbox only: vitest discovery (`npx vitest list`) is refused by the network proxy (registry.npmjs.org 403), as in P5.4. `scripts/t baseline --compare -p core,media,drive,webhooks,documents,collaboration,azgard,filament,repo,hub` exits 0.

Fixed on the spot (D43): tests/suites.json did not list P5.4's packages/collaboration/tests/Persistence/LockingReadsTest.php, so scripts/t never ran it and tests/Repo/TestRunnerTest ('the inventory covers every test file') was red. Added, together with the new test files. tests/baseline/CHANGES.json had two P5.1 replacement names for CollaborationRegistrarTest with a trailing '.' that discovery no longer produces; refreshing collaboration.list made the documents compare fail, so I corrected both names and regenerated CHANGES.md.

Protocol detail chosen (D44, detail level): the lease answer is a top-level JSON array, as the protocol section writes it, and each entry carries more than the listed fields: checkpoint_version (the hub must repeat it as expected_checkpoint_version), type, schema_version, checkpoint (base64|null), content (JSON seed when there is no checkpoint) and tail [{seq, update_id, payload}], read under the same locks as the lease. The worker has no room token, so it cannot use `load`. The response stops granting further leases once the entries carry max_state_bytes of state. `document` is the node id (string). Route name: vaulter.v1.collaboration.hub.compaction.lease. Problem: collaboration_checkpoint_conflict = 409, retryable after_refetch, receipt never; context.reason is lease | coverage | checkpoint_version.

Documents behaviour added for C8 ('revision snapshot, then close G'): DocumentStateWriter::write, before a write that moves collab_epoch (restore, or a JSON replace of a document with Yjs state), captures the working state as an autosave revision when it has Yjs state and no checkpoint holds it yet. A restore after a drain therefore keeps every saved receipt in a revision. Applies to v1-store-written states too.

pending: Liveness until P5.7: the protocol 1 store (PersistCollaborationStateAction) still writes state_version outside the log. If it writes while a protocol 2 log exists for the generation, CV != SV and every publication of that generation loses with checkpoint_version, so the marker stays until the generation closes.

Performance: every lease call scans the open head rows (retired_at IS NULL, then drain_requested_at / head_seq > checkpoint_seq) without a supporting index, and computes byte/age triggers per pending candidate with one aggregate over its tail. PendingPurgeDrain (P5.3) drains trashed pending documents one after another, each up to 10 s.
